question: If I put my Dutch Oven in the oven at 475°F and the lid knob melts, is that covered by the 10-year enamel warranty?
reference_answer: No, the lid knob is not covered by the 10-year enamel warranty, as it is only covered by the standard 1-year warranty. Additionally, the knob is only rated to 450°F, so damage from heating it to 475°F would not be considered a defect in materials or workmanship.
source_text:
Warranty > Dutch Oven enamel warranty

The Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven has a longer warranty on its enamel: 10 years from the delivery date. It covers chipping, cracking and crazing of the enamel under normal home use. It does not cover damage from sudden temperature change, impact, metal utensils or steel wool. All other parts of the Dutch Oven, including the lid knob, have the standard 1-year warranty.

Warranty > What the warranty covers
It covers defects in materials and workmanship, such as a seam that splits under normal use, a hinge that fails, a zipper that breaks or a coating that peels without being misused.

---

Kitchen Products > Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven (5.5 qt)

The Dutch Oven is enameled cast iron and weighs 12.4 lb. It comes in three colors: Sea Glass, Oat and Charcoal. It is oven safe to 500°F (260°C). The lid knob is rated only to 450°F (232°C), so use the lid at lower temperatures or swap the knob. It works on gas, electric, ceramic and induction cooktops. We recommend hand washing. It is dishwasher safe, but repeated dishwasher cycles can dull the enamel over time.

Kitchen Products > Dutch Oven care
Use wooden or silicone utensils. Metal utensils can scratch the enamel. Do not heat the empty pot on high heat, and do not put a hot pot into cold water, because sudden temperature change can crack the enamel. Soak stuck-on food in warm water and use a nylon scrubber. Do not use steel wool.

question: If I am a new Tidewell Club member, can I use the WELCOME10 promo code on my first order, and will I earn store credit on that purchase?
reference_answer: Yes, you can use the WELCOME10 promo code because it can be combined with Tidewell Club benefits. You will earn 5% store credit on the merchandise price, provided the order meets the $30 subtotal requirement for the promo code and the items are not returned within 30 days.
source_text:
Tidewell Club and Gift Cards > What the Tidewell Club is

The Tidewell Club is our paid membership. It costs $29 per year. The price was $24 per year until December 31, 2024, and became $29 on January 1, 2025.

Tidewell Club and Gift Cards > Club benefits
- Free Standard shipping on all US orders, including Alaska and Hawaii, with no minimum order. The heavy-item surcharge still applies.
- 5% back in store credit on merchandise. The 5% is calculated on the item price only, not on shipping, tax or gift cards.
- Early access to sales, 24 hours before everyone else.

Tidewell Club and Gift Cards > When Club store credit arrives
The 5% store credit is added to your account 31 days after your order is delivered, which is just after the 30-day return window closes. If you return an item, you do not get credit for it.

---

Pricing, Payments and Promotions > Promo codes

You can use one promo code per order. Promo codes cannot be combined with each other. They can be combined with Tidewell Club benefits. The code WELCOME10 gives 10% off the first order of a new customer. It needs a merchandise subtotal of at least $30 before tax and does not apply to gift cards or Final Sale items. WELCOME10 can be used once per customer.

question: If I receive a Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven as a gift, what do I need to provide to make a warranty claim?
reference_answer: To make a warranty claim for a gift, you must provide the order number or the gift receipt. This is required because the 1-year limited warranty is tied to the original purchase and is not transferable.
source_text:
Warranty > Standard warranty

Every Tidewell Home product has a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. The year starts on the delivery date. The warranty belongs to the original purchaser and cannot be transferred, but a gift recipient can make a claim with the order number or the gift receipt.

---

About Tidewell Home

*Tidewell Home is a fictional company created for software testing. Every name, price, policy and date in these documents is invented.*

About Tidewell Home > Who we are
Tidewell Home is an online shop for home goods. It was founded in 2019 by siblings Rena and Colby Vance. Our head office is in Portland, Oregon, and every order ships from our fulfillment center in Reno, Nevada. We sell online only. We have no physical stores, so in-store pickup is not available.

About Tidewell Home > What we sell
We sell about 140 products in five categories: Kitchen, Bedding, Bath, Storage and Outdoor. Our best-known products are the Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven, the Linen Sheet Set, the Turkish Cotton Towel Set and the Cedar Chest. A full price list is in the product catalog document.

About Tidewell Home > Prices and time zone
All prices on our website are in US dollars (USD). Every cutoff time, support hour and deadline in our policies uses Pacific Time (PT), which means Pacific Standard Time in winter and Pacific Daylight Time in summer.

About Tidewell Home > Packaging
Since March 1, 2023, every order ships in 100% recycled cardboard, with no plastic mailers and no plastic fill. Orders that contain glassware or stoneware use molded paper-pulp cushioning instead of crinkle paper. The packing slip is printed on recycled paper. If an order is marked as a gift, the packing slip hides all prices.

About Tidewell Home > Shipping emissions
We offset the carbon emissions of all Standard shipments through a verified offset partner. Expedited and Overnight shipments are not offset. The offset is paid by Tidewell Home and never added to your order total.

About Tidewell Home > How to reach us
Email support@tidewellhome.example or call +1 (555) 010-0142. Support hours and escalation steps are in the support and contact document.

question: If I am signed in to my account and use my store credit along with a credit card for an order, when will my card be charged?
reference_answer: Your card will be charged at the time you place the order, unless the order contains pre-order items, which are charged on the day they ship. You are allowed to use up to two payment methods, such as store credit and a credit card, for your transaction.
source_text:
Website and Checkout Help > Supported browsers

Website and Checkout Help > Entering your address
Use a street address for Expedited and Overnight orders. We cannot deliver Expedited or Overnight to a PO box. If your address is flagged by the carrier as incomplete, we may contact you before shipping.

Website and Checkout Help > Signing in with a one-time code
You can sign in with an emailed one-time code instead of a password. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once.

Website and Checkout Help > Using store credit and gift cards at checkout
Enter the gift card code in the Gift Card box. Store credit is applied automatically if you are signed in. If your balance does not cover the full total, choose a second payment method for the rest. You can use at most 2 payment methods in total.

Website and Checkout Help > Accessibility
We aim to follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 level AA on our website. If you find a part of the site that you cannot use, tell support and we will help you place the order by phone or email.

Website and Checkout Help > Reporting a website problem
Email support with the page address, what you expected, what happened, your browser and a screenshot if possible. We do not offer a bug bounty program.

---

Pricing, Payments and Promotions > Accepted payment methods

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Tidewell gift cards and Tidewell store credit. We do not accept cash on delivery, checks, money orders or cryptocurrency. We do not offer buy-now-pay-later plans or monthly installment payments at this time.

Pricing, Payments and Promotions > When you are charged
Your card is charged when you place the order. The only exception is pre-order items, which are charged on the day they ship. If your card is declined, the order is not placed and no hold stays on your account.

Pricing, Payments and Promotions > Paying with two methods
You can split one order across up to 2 payment methods, for example store credit plus one card. Gift cards and store credit count as payment methods.

Pricing, Payments and Promotions > Sales tax
We collect sales tax in the states where we are required to, based on the shipping address. Tax is shown at checkout before you pay. Canadian orders are not charged US sales tax, but duties and taxes apply at the border (see the shipping policy).

Pricing, Payments and Promotions > Currency
All prices and charges are in US dollars, including orders to Canada. Your bank may add a currency conversion fee, which we do not control.
